{{Top|leg}}
'''Mold''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. A specific type of mold was [[vohis mold]], which was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] and could be dried out to add flavor to [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] used the plant as the main component of [[mold stew]].<ref name="MIS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
